subject: Kickoff: contrastive RL as our goal-conditioned baseline
body:
Team,

Kicking off the contrastive RL workstream. The claim in our open-source release is the interesting one for us: apply contrastive representation learning to action-labeled trajectories and the inner product of the learned representations *is* the goal-conditioned value function. No auxiliary losses, no data augmentation, and it still beats the non-contrastive baselines on image-based tasks.

Why I care as PM: our current goal-conditioned stack is three losses in a trenchcoat and every new task needs someone to retune the augmentation pipeline. If this holds up, we delete a whole category of tuning work.

Milestones in the Apr 6 - Jul 27 window:
- May 8: reproduce state-based success rates on the standard goal-conditioned suite.
- Jun 19: image-based tasks, no augmentation, head-to-head vs our current agent.
- Jul 17: recommendation memo - adopt, or park.

Deshawn will send resourcing. Hyun is tech lead.

Ulla
